wildlife.definition: wild animals and plants living in their natural environment.

willing.definition: ready and happy to do something without needing to be persuaded.

willingly.definition: happily and without needing to be forced or persuaded.

wind.definition: the natural movement of air, especially a current of air blowing from one place to another.

winger.definition: a player in a team sport, such as football, who plays on the side of the pitch.

winner.definition: the person or team that is most successful in a competition or contest.

winning.definition: being the most successful in a competition or contest.

wins.definition: is the most successful in a competition, game or contest.

winter.definition: the coldest season of the year, between autumn and spring.

wise.definition: having or showing good judgement, based on knowledge and experience.

wisely.definition: in a sensible way that shows good judgement.

wish.definition: a desire or hope for something to happen, or to want something to happen.

witness.definition: a person who sees an event happen, especially a crime or accident, or to see something happen.

witnessed.definition: saw something happen, especially an event or incident.

won.definition: was successful in a competition or contest, finishing ahead of everyone else.

wonder.definition: to feel curious about something and want to know more.

wonderfully.definition: in a way that is extremely good, impressive or pleasing.

words.definition: units of language that carry meaning, spoken or written.

workable.definition: practical and likely to succeed if used or carried out.

workers.definition: people who do jobs, especially involving physical or practical effort.

workers'.definition: belonging to people who do jobs, especially involving physical or practical effort.

working.definition: doing a job or task, or, of a machine or method, functioning correctly.

works.definition: functions or operates as intended, or does a job.

world.definition: the earth, along with all its countries, peoples and natural features.

worry.definition: to feel anxious or troubled about something that might happen.

worse.definition: More bad than something else; of lower quality.

worth.definition: having a particular value, especially in money, or deserving something.

worthwhile.definition: important, valuable or rewarding enough to justify the time or effort spent on it.

wound.definition: moved in a series of curves or bends, following a twisting course.

wrapping.definition: covering something completely by folding paper, cloth or another material around it.

wristbands.definition: bands worn around the wrist, often to show that someone has paid to enter an event.

writers.definition: people whose job or skill is producing books, articles or other texts.

wrong.definition: not correct, or not morally right.

wrongly.definition: in a way that is incorrect or unfair.

wrote.definition: communicated something by putting words down in a letter, message or other piece of writing, at a time in the past

years.definition: periods of twelve months, used to describe a long stretch of time

young.definition: having lived or existed for only a short time; not old

youngest.definition: having lived for the shortest time among a group of people, especially siblings

youth.definition: young people thought of as a group, especially teenagers and those in their early twenties

zealous.definition: Very enthusiastic and eager about something.

zone.definition: a particular area or section of a place, marked out because it has a special purpose or feature

zoo.definition: a place where various kinds of wild animals are kept so the public can see them
